name: .620 Cal-900gr Stone Hammer®
note: Minimum required twist rate for dangerous game hunting is 1-29″ or faster. Recommended use: Big Game and Dangerous Game Hunting. The product page also says: "Designed for the 600 Nitro Express double guns, this pure copper Stone Hammer™ will put a wallop on any big game or dangerous game animal you want to pursue. Designed to open the nose and shed the petals to retain a flat frontal retained shank for deep penetration and permanent wound channel that will be massive."
